summary: Lead research for Historian MVP (local history/genealogy platform). Targets historical societies, libraries, genealogical organizations, and archives in Ashtabula County and Ohio that could benefit from digital history preservation, genealogy tools, and local heritage documentation.

leads.fit_rationale: Founded in 1838, second oldest historical society in Ohio. Digital archiving and genealogy tools would enhance their preservation mission and expand access to their collections.
Maintains comprehensive genealogical sources and local history archives. Digital research tools would improve accessibility for family history researchers.
Supports family history research in Ashtabula County. Digital genealogy platform would assist members with research tools and record access.
Preserves Jefferson's abolitionist history and local heritage. Digital history tools would expand their outreach and documentation capabilities.
State archives preserving Ohio history for 50+ years. Local history platform integration would support county-level historical documentation.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add searchable digital archive for historical documents and photographs.
Include family tree builder with local record integration.
Create interactive timeline of Ashtabula County historical events.
Add crowdsourced history collection for community contributions.
Provide cemetery and burial records mapping.
Include historical map overlays with modern geographic data.
Add oral history recording and preservation tools.
Create educational modules for local school history curriculum.

possible_issues: History platforms need respectful, scholarly design—flashy modern aesthetics may undermine credibility.
Poor search functionality frustrates genealogists looking for specific records.
Without mobile optimization, field researchers cannot access records on location.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Local history platforms are highly white-labelable for county historical societies, genealogy groups, or regional heritage organizations with custom branding.
